services.name: SoundTest_RunScreen
services.behavior: Loads the sound-test presentation, renders the selected entry, services AnimationVM/MovementVM and sprite submission each frame, polls controller bits, debounces navigation through SOUND_TEST_INPUT_REPEAT_TIMER, queues playback, and returns after the exit input path.

services.name: SoundTest_SelectPreviousEntry
services.behavior: Subtracts 0x10 from SOUND_TEST_ENTRY_PTR, rejects the 0xFF sentinel, and redraws the selected entry when a prior record exists.

services.name: SoundTest_SelectNextEntry
services.behavior: Adds 0x10 to SOUND_TEST_ENTRY_PTR, rejects the 0xFF sentinel, and redraws the selected entry when a following record exists.

services.name: SoundTest_PlaySelectedEntry
services.behavior: Reads the first byte of the current 0x10-byte record at SOUND_TEST_ENTRY_PTR and sends that value through the audio command queue.

services.name: SoundTest_RenderSelectedEntry
services.behavior: Processes the fixed sound-test presentation stream at 0x00128E4D and nine row commands derived from SOUND_TEST_ENTRY_PTR before processing the closing command stream.

services.name: Credits_RunRoll
services.behavior: Sets up the transition presentation, consumes the command/text stream at 0x00127E8C, advances actor/render frames for each stream row, applies palette steps, and exits on the stream terminator.

evidence.sound_test_entry_table: ROM 0x0012675E begins the 0x10-byte records: each record starts with an audio command byte followed by a display string, and records use 0xFF sentinel bytes. The initial pointer is published as 0x0012675E by the startup path.

conclusion: The menu's sound-test and credits branches are now represented as named, bounded services. Their exact stream/pointer/timer contracts are established without inferring broader audio asset identities or the meaning of every presentation command.
